04 · SEM ACTIVATION · PAID SEARCH

Turn your content evidence into a Search campaign blueprint i

Media Content House prepares the search architecture; MQL executes budget, bidding, realised cost and lead performance. The laboratory always proposes a Top 10 paid-search shortlist, even when the project has not yet committed media investment.

1 · IntentPrioritise searches that signal a real commercial decision.
2 · MatchUse Broad, Phrase or Exact deliberately; do not treat them as interchangeable.
3 · Ad groupKeep each keyword close to one promise, one landing route and one search-ad message.
4 · TrackingPreserve campaign, content, keyword and match-type evidence for MQL attribution.
Current Google Ads guardrail: Keyword Planner is the place to validate monthly searches and cost forecasts; this laboratory deliberately leaves those fields as TO VALIDATE rather than inventing them. Google Ads currently supports Broad, Phrase and Exact keyword match types, and Responsive Search Ads can contain up to 15 headlines and 4 descriptions.

05 · TRACTION PLAN · MEDIA & CONTENT

Final inventory and production package i

The current project closes with four controlled deliverables. The Traction Plan is the complete operational inventory; the MQL Recipe is the downstream execution contract; the Prompt Library preserves production instructions; and the HTML Library contains the finished tracked communication pieces plus the source-asset manifest.

00 · SEM ACTIVATION

SEM Activation Plan

Excel package with the Top 10 paid-search keywords, match types, ad groups, Responsive Search Ad assets, tracking templates and MQL Search handoff. Search volume and CPC forecasts remain marked for Keyword Planner validation.

01 · PLAN

Traction Plan · Media & Content

Excel inventory of every Medium, Support, Format, POSE role, destination, UTM, KPI target, creative source and HTML filename. Campaign spend is completed downstream in MQL.

02 · MQL HANDOFF

MQL Media Plan Recipe

Excel execution contract for MQL: final Paid / Owned / Shared / Earned inventory, exact UTMs, measurement model, CPM / CTR targets, planned exposure and handoff targets. MQL owns campaign cost execution.

03 · PROMPTS

Prompt Library

ZIP with one structured production prompt per saved content asset, grouped from the current project configuration.

04 · HTML LIBRARY

HTML Creative Library

ZIP with finished first-mobile HTML pieces, embedded tracked URLs, manifests and source-image references for the current project.

METHODOLOGY AT THE END OF THE JOURNEY

DIIIP explains why this media-content connection creates value

In Media Content House, value appears when marketing evidence and approved imagery become a validated, measurable and reusable communication asset.

D
Data

Raw inputs: Marketing Planning evidence, Buyer Persona language, approved imagery, objectives, budgets, attribution signals and creative constraints.

I
Information

The inputs are structured as marketing policy, creative source, format, medium, support, POSE, destination, UTM, metrics and cost.

I
Intelligence

UX and media rules interpret the information through mobile-first validation, format compatibility, message hierarchy, tracking logic and economic planning.

I
Insights

The laboratory reveals creative gaps, channel-fit problems, tracking inconsistencies, cost assumptions and opportunities to improve measurable customer response.

P
Personalization Actions

Validated assets activate Web / Blog, Social Media, Email and Display communication and travel downstream as a traceable Traction Plan for MQL execution.

KAI·ROI EQUATION · CUSTOMER EQUITY

Media Content House creates operational evidence for the KAI·ROI layer

Media Content House does not redefine KAI·ROI. It creates structured evidence about content, media, acquisition cost, customer response and traceable activation that can later support ROI analysis, Customer Equity reasoning and defensible strategic decisions.

The formal KAI·ROI structure remains sovereign; this laboratory creates evidence and does not reinterpret its variables.
